bias.en: Uptrend, pulling back · reclaimed $515, testing the short averages
bias.zh: 上升趋势回调 · 收复 $515，测试短期均线

read.en: Microsoft rose 2.7% on Nov 3 to $520.99, trading between $507.85 and $523.44. It is just below the falling 5-day ($522.2) and 10-day ($525.4) and the rising 30-day ($524.1), and above the rising 100-day ($467.9) and 200-day ($438.5). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 19 but above zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($539.84), and RSI is 49.
read.zh: 微软 11月3日上涨 2.7%，收于 $520.99，盘中区间 $507.85–523.44。股价略低于下行的 5 日（$522.2）和 10 日均线（$525.4）以及上行的 30 日均线（$524.1），并位于上行的 100 日（$467.9）和 200 日均线（$438.5）上方。MACD 自 10月19日起位于信号线下方但仍在零轴之上，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$539.84），RSI 为 49。

read.en: The close reclaimed the $514.4–515.7 level (Oct 30 and Oct 23 lows) lost on Nov 2, now support again. Resistance is $522.2–525.4 (5, 30 and 10-day, Nov 3 high), then $529.6–532.6 (Nov 2 high, Oct 26–28 closes) and $539.8–541.3 (SAR, Oct 29 high). Support is $514.4–515.7, then $505–507.9 (Nov 2–3 lows) and $497.3–502.4. A close above $525.4 would target $530–533; below $514, $505.

s.en: Oct 30 low $514.35 and Oct 23 low $515.7, reclaimed
